title: Floor 6 Hold for Renovation hero tower defense
description: Implement Floor 6 as an original, deterministic hero tower-defense episode in a compact production set: the Crawler fights inside the lanes, gathers wave loot, builds and upgrades defenses at authored sites, and survives an escalating broadcast schedule through a final Deadline wave. The floor uses familiar genre readability without reproducing any protected characters, names, maps, dialogue, art, or distinctive expression from other works.

review.body: This manifest is the complete planning source for Floor 6 until slice 1 lands its content bible, system spec, and ADR. Canon sources already in the repository are docs/knowledge/game-design/lore-bible.md and docs/knowledge/game-design/game-design-document.md; Floor 4 is precedent only for a constrained, wave-driven production set, and Floor 5 is precedent only for deterministic autonomous pressure and dependency-complete epic slices. HUMAN_GATE before approval: confirm the episode title, the defend-the-Relay terminal objective, the authored tower-site model, the rule that the Crawler remains an active combatant rather than becoming a cursor, and the run-scoped upgrade model. Numeric decisions for wave count/cadence, tower costs and caps, loot yield, upgrade values, boss pressure, floor duration, completion rate, and frame/entity budgets are explicitly DEFERRED to slice-9-balance-and-release because they require representative runtime evidence. Approval accepts that evidence-first deferral; it does not approve numbers. Every implementation must remain original and may borrow only unprotectable genre conventions.

nodes.title: Floor 6 Slice 1: canon-backed content bible, system spec, and architecture contract
nodes.body: Author the Floor 6 content bible, deterministic system spec, and cross-system ADR before runtime work. Fix the original production-set identity, compact lane layout, Relay defense objective, phase/terminal precedence, authored tower-site rules, wave and loot authority, run-scoped upgrade lifecycle, boss framing, safe build-break behavior, ownership boundaries, RNG streams, data schemas, telemetry, and HUMAN_GATE register. Trace the Lore Bible/GDD and explicitly distinguish the floor from Floor 4's survival arena and Floor 5's siege. Do not copy protected names, characters, maps, dialogue, visual designs, or distinctive expression from any inspiration. Done when docs/lore checks pass, every later slice maps to numbered requirements and acceptance tests, unresolved mechanics are assigned to the correct persona instead of silently decided by Content Design, and a human approves the named non-numeric decisions.

nodes.title: Floor 6 Slice 2: floor plumbing, compact defense map, phases, and parity lab
nodes.body: Implement the approved Floor 6 manifest/registry/scenario foundation and one compact authored production set with a player ingress, protected Broadcast Relay, readable enemy routes, authored build sites, wave entrances, loot-safe pickup access, break enclosure, and victory exit. Add the floor phase skeleton, isolated seeded RNG stream keys, deterministic semantic geometry, required lab, and the same ScenarioDefinition wiring for windowed and headless execution. No tower, wave, or economy behavior belongs in this slice. Done when the real windowed game and headless runner load byte-equivalent reachable map/phase artifacts, every route reaches the Relay for all supported footprints, every build site is legal and non-blocking, and Floor 6 remains unreleased until the release slice passes.

nodes.title: Floor 6 Slice 3: immutable wave schedule, route pressure, caps, and terminal loss
nodes.body: Implement the spec's single-authority wave director, immutable seeded wave manifests, telegraphed entrances, deterministic route assignment, bounded live-enemy caps and spawn debt, break transitions, and immediate Relay-destruction defeat precedence. Enemy movement and targeting must reuse or extend the deterministic AI contracts owned by Game AI; wave state must not be inferred from rendering or quest flags. Add enemy roster data only through validated registries and keep balance values manifest/tuning driven. Done when headless replays produce identical manifests and phase traces, enemies traverse every approved route without stalls, debt is bounded and cleared at specified boundaries, same-tick Relay loss beats progress, and no run can wait forever for a missing wave entity.

nodes.title: Floor 6 Slice 4: wave loot, build currency, and run-scoped upgrade offers
nodes.body: Implement the approved Floor 6 economy as validated data plus deterministic runtime contracts: enemy and wave rewards, collectible build currency, ordinary loot compatibility, seeded without-replacement upgrade offers, purchase/selection transactions, and explicit reset/carryover rules. Separate persistent inventory from floor-scoped construction resources; no tower cost or upgrade effect may be hard-coded in UI or content prose. Ensure skipped or missed pickups cannot soft-lock mandatory progression, and isolate offer RNG from combat timing. Done when focused/property tests prove conservation and non-negative balances, identical seeds and decision traces yield identical offers, rejected or unaffordable transactions are atomic no-ops, floor-scoped state cannot leak across runs, and a headless run can collect loot and unlock at least one upgrade through the real pipeline.

nodes.title: Floor 6 Slice 5: authored-site tower construction, upgrades, targeting, and teardown
nodes.body: Implement the approved starter tower roster as validated data and generic tower contracts: site occupancy, build/upgrade/sell transactions, tower entities/components, deterministic target selection, attacks/effects, range and line-of-sight rules, bounded summons/projectiles, and end-of-floor teardown. Construction is limited to authored sites and must never alter route topology; UI may request transactions but cannot own state. Tower definitions must be original and use existing combat/damage primitives wherever possible. Done when tests and the real headless scenario build every starter tower, reject illegal or double occupancy atomically, apply every upgrade exactly once, choose stable legal targets under ties, preserve passable routes, clean up all floor-scoped entities, and replay to an identical combat trace for the same seed and decisions.

nodes.title: Floor 6 Slice 6: active Crawler combat, tower synergy, and headless strategy
nodes.body: Integrate the existing playable Crawler combat, abilities, pickups, equipment, death handling, and movement with the defense scenario so the player remains a hero fighting among the towers rather than a detached build cursor. Add only spec-approved tower/hero synergy hooks through data-driven effects, plus a deterministic scenario-AI strategy that can choose sites, collect resources, purchase upgrades, fight priority threats, and retreat without omniscient runtime shortcuts. Preserve the existing core combat ownership boundaries. Done when windowed controls remain the normal Crawler controls, headless completes a build-loot-upgrade-wave loop using public game state, player death and Relay loss resolve by the approved precedence, and towers alone cannot satisfy any explicitly hero-gated acceptance case.

nodes.title: Floor 6 Slice 7: escalation acts, Deadline boss wave, payout, and terminal victory
nodes.body: Implement the full phase arc defined by slice 1: escalating defense acts, safe and bounded build breaks, the fixed Broadcast Deadline finale, boss/add manifests, legal tower and hero interactions, one-shot victory payout, and opened exit. The boss must pressure the established routes/Relay without bypassing tower rules or introducing an unbounded encounter, and defeat/victory must be authoritative state rather than entity absence or presentation. Done when a real headless run survives each act, enters and exits every break with no hostile activity, defeats the Deadline encounter, awards payout exactly once, opens the exit exactly once, and records one terminal outcome; same-tick defeat precedence, boss timeout/backstop, and cleanup paths have focused regression coverage.

nodes.title: Floor 6 Slice 8: quests, Director voice, HUD, audio, art, and visual proof
nodes.body: Ship the Floor 6 declarative quest pack through the existing validated registry/install flow, authored static Director lines, objective/wave/Relay/resource/site/tower/upgrade/boss HUD, accessible telegraphs, deterministic audio/VFX cues, original enemy/tower/production-set assets, and set-piece dressing. Quest goals must project authoritative scenario state and must not reimplement it as floor-specific booleans; no runtime LLM generation is allowed. Follow the asset and set-piece pipelines rather than landing placeholders as final art. Done when deterministic real-game captures at gameplay scale prove routes, buildable versus occupied sites, tower ranges/tiers, incoming wave direction, Relay danger, loot, upgrade choices, break safety, and Deadline escalation without color-only meaning, while docs/lore/data validation confirms original on-tone copy.

nodes.title: Floor 6 Slice 9: integrated QA, evidence-backed balance, achievements, and release gate
nodes.body:
Owner: QA Engineer.

Add integrated/property/E2E/headless gates, achievements as validated data, and telemetry for phase durations, wave manifests, leaks, Relay health, build/upgrade choices, loot flow, hero versus tower contribution, boss state, path stalls, live entities, frame cost, cleanup, and terminal integrity. Verify each achievement unlocks after its measurable objective and that its reward can be claimed exactly once. Obtain every deferred numeric HUMAN_GATE approval using representative GitHub-backed sweeps: wave count/cadence and caps, route pressure, tower roster/costs/caps/range/damage, loot and offer rates, upgrade values, break duration, Deadline timing, floor duration, completion-rate target, Relay-health cushion, and frame/entity budgets. Tune through owned data paths; do not weaken sensors or cherry-pick seeds. Done when unlock, claim, and reward assertions pass, achievements uniquely match their measured requirements, no objective is unreachable, no route/build/economy state soft-locks, no run is non-terminal, visual/runtime evidence is attached, the floor is marked released through the registry's existing release path, and repository fast/PR prerequisite gates are green.
